description: Pine Bottle is a Korean injectable lipolysis solution formulated deliberately without deoxycholic acid (DC) or phosphatidylcholine (PPC), instead relying on an enzyme- and vitamin-based trio. It is positioned as a gentler alternative for face and body contouring with a lower swelling profile than classic bile-acid formulas. Supplied as 10 ml x 5 vials for staged, progressive treatment.
howItWorks: In place of the bile-acid pathway, lecithin emulsifies and helps break down stored triglycerides within the subcutaneous fat layer while bromelain acts as an anti-inflammatory proteolytic enzyme and riboflavin supports fat metabolism and cellular energy. Liberated lipids are mobilised and cleared through the lymphatic and vascular circulation. Because it is DC/PPC-free, membrane-disruptive irritation and post-injection swelling tend to be more manageable than with deoxycholate-based products.
composition: Lecithin, Bromelain (pineapple / Ananas sativus fruit extract), Riboflavin (Vitamin B2). Free of deoxycholic acid and phosphatidylcholine (DC/PPC-free).
usageNotes: For clinician use only. Administer as multiple small subcutaneous deposits across a grid pattern within the target fat pad using conservative per-point volumes; avoid intramuscular or intradermal placement. Localised swelling, tenderness and bruising are expected and should be counselled in advance. Stage treatment across sessions (approximately 4-week intervals) rather than over-treating in a single visit. Maintain awareness of regional nerve and vascular anatomy, particularly the marginal mandibular nerve when treating the jawline and submental region.
features: DC/PPC-free enzyme-and-vitamin lipolysis formula
Lecithin, bromelain and riboflavin actives
Lower swelling profile than bile-acid solutions
Suitable for both facial and body areas
Supplied 10 ml x 5 vials for staged protocols
benefits: Gentler adverse-event profile supports patient tolerability and retention
Versatile across face and body indications from a single SKU
Predictable staged protocol aids scheduling and repeat visits
Positioned as a differentiated non-bile-acid option in the lipolysis category
Convenient multi-vial packaging for clinic inventory

description: Curenex Lipo is a Korean injectable lipolysis solution marketed for non-surgical slimming and contouring of the face and body. It is promoted as a botanically derived formulation intended to reduce localised fat volume while supporting skin firmness. Developed by K Derma Co., Ltd. under the Curenex brand.
howItWorks: Curenex Lipo is described by the manufacturer as working in phases: mobilising and increasing metabolism of fatty acids within adipocytes, improving local microcirculation, and stimulating collagen for skin firmness. Released lipids are carried away and metabolised via the bloodstream and lymphatic clearance. Note that, unlike classic deoxycholic acid / PPC injectables, the manufacturer positions the fat-reduction action around plant-derived actives rather than bile-acid membrane lysis.
composition: Botanical / plant-derived extracts (described as leaf, bud and stem extracts). Specific active concentrations are not publicly disclosed by the manufacturer.
usageNotes: For clinician use only. Delivered as subcutaneous injections across the target fat compartment using fine needles (commonly 27G-30G) in a distributed grid; use conservative per-point volumes and stage treatment across sessions (commonly around 7-10 day intervals for a course of about three sessions). Counsel patients that swelling, tenderness and bruising can occur. Observe regional nerve and vascular anatomy, especially around the submental and jawline zones.
features: Botanically positioned lipolysis solution
Marketed for face and body slimming
Claimed skin-firming / collagen-supporting action
Fine-needle subcutaneous administration
Short staged treatment course
benefits: Plant-derived positioning appeals to patients seeking non-bile-acid options
Dual contouring and skin-firming marketing narrative
Short inter-session intervals support a defined treatment package
Applicable across multiple face and body zones
Non-surgical, low-downtime clinic offering
indications: Buccal fat and facial V-line contouring

description: Bijunel Slim Fit Solution is a Korean injectable meso-lipolysis cocktail from Hanchung Medical's Bijunel line, formulated for subcutaneous fat reduction and body-line slimming. It combines a fat-mobilising base with botanical extracts and skin-supporting peptides intended to break down localised fat while improving circulation and skin quality. Supplied as 10 cc vials (5 vials per box).
howItWorks: The formulation is reported to combine a bile-acid / carnitine fat-metabolism pathway with enzymatic and botanical actives: deoxycholate and carnitine drive breakdown and transport of fatty acids, while lecithin, bromelain and riboflavin support emulsification and reduce inflammation. Mobilised lipids are cleared through the lymphatic and vascular circulation. Adjunct actives such as copper tripeptide-1 are included to support skin renewal and local blood flow during the fat-clearance process.
composition: Reported to include Deoxycholate and Carnitine alongside botanical and skin actives: Water, Glucose, Juglans regia (walnut) seed extract, Aesculus hippocastanum (horse chestnut) extract, Caffeine, Glycerin, Copper Tripeptide-1; enhanced versions also cite Lecithin, Bromelain, Riboflavin and Lactoferrin. Exact concentrations are not disclosed.
usageNotes: For clinician use only. Inject subcutaneously into the target fat pad across a distributed grid using conservative per-point volumes; avoid intramuscular and intradermal placement. Counsel patients that swelling, tenderness and bruising are expected. Stage treatment over a course (typically a minimum of 3 sessions at roughly 3-5 week intervals) rather than over-treating in one visit. Maintain awareness of regional nerve and vascular anatomy, particularly around the jawline and submental region.

description: DR LIPO + is a Korean PPC-based injectable lipolysis solution from BNC Global, formulated for direct subcutaneous fat reduction across the body. It pairs the classic bile-acid membrane-lytic mechanism with carnitine, growth factors and peptides intended to support skin tone during fat clearance. Typically supplied as 10 ml x 10 vials for body-area treatment.
howItWorks: Phosphatidylcholine (PPC) and sodium deoxycholate disrupt adipocyte cell membranes, causing fat-cell death and emulsification of the released lipids. The emulsified lipid content is then mobilised and cleared through the lymphatic and vascular systems and excreted via normal metabolic routes. Because fat cells are destroyed rather than merely shrunk, the manufacturer frames results as durable; adjunct carnitine, EGF/FGF1 and peptides are included to support metabolism and skin recovery.
composition: Phosphatidylcholine (PPC) and Sodium Deoxycholate (active lipolytics); plus Carnitine, EGF, FGF1, and peptides including Acetyl Hexapeptide-8, Palmitoyl Pentapeptide-4, Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7 and Nicotinoyl Tripeptide, in an aqueous base.
usageNotes: For clinician use only. Administer as multiple small subcutaneous deposits in a grid across the target fat compartment, using conservative per-point volumes and staying within the fat layer (avoid muscle and dermis). PPC/DC formulas produce pronounced, expected swelling, erythema and tenderness that must be counselled in advance. Stage treatment across sessions (commonly ~10-day intervals for a course of 2-5 sessions, with longer gaps as fat is permanently reduced). Maintain strict awareness of regional nerve and vascular anatomy for each body zone.
features: PPC + sodium deoxycholate dual-active lipolysis
Adjunct carnitine, growth factors and peptides
Formulated for larger body fat compartments
Manufacturer claims durable (non yo-yo) fat-cell destruction
Supplied 10 ml x 10 vials
benefits: Established bile-acid mechanism with a recognisable clinical rationale
Body-focused volume packaging suits larger treatment areas
Peptide and growth-factor adjuncts add a skin-support marketing angle
Defined multi-session protocol supports treatment packaging
Named Korean manufacturer supports supply traceability
indications: Flanks / love handles and back fat
Inner and outer thighs and knees
Arms and upper back / bra-line fat
Buttock and hip contouring / cellulite appearance

description: DR LIPO V is the facial V-line variant of BNC Global's PPC-based injectable lipolysis line, formulated for fine subcutaneous contouring of the face. It targets submental and lower-face fat to sharpen the jaw and V-line while including growth factors and vitamins intended to support skin lifting. Typically supplied as 5 ml x 10 vials for delicate facial dosing.
howItWorks: Phosphatidylcholine (PPC) and deoxycholic acid disrupt adipocyte membranes to break down and emulsify facial fat, with the released lipids cleared via the lymphatic and vascular circulation. The reduced fat layer, combined with claimed collagen and elastin stimulation from adjunct peptides and growth factors, is marketed to tighten and lift the treated area. The lower per-vial volume reflects the smaller, more precise deposits required in facial anatomy.
composition: Phosphatidylcholine (PPC) and Deoxycholic acid (active lipolytics); plus peptides (Acetyl Hexapeptide-8, Palmitoyl Pentapeptide-4, Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7), EGF, Carnitine, Vitamin B-complex and Vitamin C.
usageNotes: For clinician use only. Use fine ultra-thin needles to place small, conservative subcutaneous deposits in a grid across the submental and lower-face fat, remaining superficial to muscle. Expect and pre-counsel marked swelling and tenderness, which is particularly conspicuous in the face and can persist for several days. Stage treatment across 2-3 sessions at ~10-day intervals. Exercise heightened caution around facial nerve and vascular anatomy, especially the marginal mandibular nerve and the submental / lower-ear zones.

description: Meline is NOT a fat-dissolving product. It is a professional depigmentation and skin-brightening line from Innoaesthetics dedicated exclusively to treating hyperpigmentation across all skin phototypes. The range pairs in-clinic peels and mesotherapy-style serums with structured home-care to fade melasma, lentigines and other discolouration.
howItWorks: Meline targets pigmentation rather than adipose tissue. It combines chemical-exfoliating acids to accelerate turnover of pigment-laden cells with melanin-synthesis inhibitors that act on the tyrosinase pathway and antioxidants that reduce oxidative pigment stimulus. Formulations are tailored by skin phototype (lighter phototypes I-III versus ethnic phototypes IV-VI) to control discolouration safely. This is a depigmenting mechanism and involves no adipocyte membrane disruption or lipolysis.
composition: Chemical-exfoliating acids, melanin-inhibiting (tyrosinase-pathway) agents and antioxidants, delivered as phototype-specific in-clinic peels/serums plus home-care products. Specific active concentrations are proprietary and not fully disclosed.
usageNotes: For clinician use only, as a depigmentation protocol (not an injectable lipolysis). Apply the in-clinic peel/serum to cleansed skin per the phototype-appropriate protocol and pair with the prescribed home-care regimen for maintenance. Counsel patients on expected transient erythema, flaking and photosensitivity, and enforce strict daily photoprotection to prevent rebound pigmentation. Patch-test and adjust intensity in higher (IV-VI) phototypes to reduce post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation risk.

Phototype-specific formulations (I-III and IV-VI)
Combined in-clinic peels/serums plus home-care line
Acts on exfoliation, melanin inhibition and antioxidant pathways
Structured professional-plus-maintenance protocol
benefits: Purpose-built pigment focus differentiates it from generic peels
Phototype-tailored options broaden the treatable patient base safely
In-clinic plus home-care model supports recurring product revenue
Comprehensive protocol simplifies staff training and standardisation
Addresses a high-demand aesthetic concern (melasma / hyperpigmentation)
indications: Lentigines / sun-induced spots and age spots
Uneven tone / general brightening across face and body

description: Lipo Shrinker is a Korean fat-decomposition injectable distributed by Mirpharma and attributed to Stun Medical, formulated for localised fat reduction with claimed skin-texture and elasticity benefits. It is marketed to target fat within adipocytes to reduce fat-cell size and cellulite appearance. Supplied in 5.5 ml vials (5 vials per box).
howItWorks: As an injection-lipolysis product, Lipo Shrinker acts on subcutaneous adipocytes to break down stored fat and reduce fat-cell size; the fat-dissolving action in this product class is driven by a bile-acid pathway (deoxycholic acid) that disrupts fat-cell membranes. Released lipids are subsequently mobilised and cleared through the lymphatic and vascular circulation. The manufacturer also claims skin-plumping and cellulite-reduction effects alongside fat breakdown.
composition: Full active composition is not disclosed on the manufacturer's product page; the product is presented as a fat-decomposition injection within the deoxycholic-acid class of lipolytics. Specific actives and concentrations are not publicly stated.
usageNotes: For clinician use only. Inject subcutaneously into the target fat pad across a distributed grid using conservative per-point volumes, remaining within the fat layer. Localised swelling, tenderness and bruising are expected and should be counselled in advance. Stage treatment across multiple sessions rather than over-treating in one visit. Maintain awareness of regional nerve and vascular anatomy, particularly around the submental region and jawline.
